data_requests.item: Existing source-specific condensate service, vent/recovery and actual operating basis
where: site records: Existing named-vessel/condensate source service and current vent/recovery/route records, actual pressure/temperature, flow and duration with quantity/units, sample time, revision, availability and operating coverage.

a walkdown: Only if existing records cannot settle an applicable question, agree safe additional observations with the responsible engineer; no compulsory new measurement, operating change or retrofit.
data_requests.how: A FLASH TANK/VESSEL/DRUM label is not proof of steam-water service, atmospheric venting, measured steam loss or an unused recovery opportunity. Establish actual current function and distinguish known nonsteam/hydrocarbon context from unknown applicable service. Review suitable existing recovery before requesting more data; pressure ratings or a plume alone do not establish a flash fraction or source quality.

data_requests.item: Existing compatible receiving-duty, association and feasibility basis
where: site records: Existing exact-source low-pressure user pressure/quality, flow/heat duty and operating-time requirements, piping/route/distance and system/practical/economic constraints.

a walkdown: Only if existing records cannot settle an applicable question, agree safe additional observations with the responsible engineer; no compulsory new measurement, operating change or retrofit.
data_requests.how: Review actual source/receiving pressure, timing and compatible duty together; a nearby or foreign/seasonal low-pressure label is not a matched sink. Supplemental original DOE Tip12 pp1–2 requires flow/duration, compatible uses and cost-effective equipment/piping, with return alternatives and availability/use considered. Acknowledge an existing suitable route or nonapplicability without a new field task. No recovery installation, physical connection, flash calculation or site savings follow from this screen.

questions.decision_rule: Review actual steam-water condensate service, current vent/recovery and matched source/receiving duty, routing and economic constraints with the responsible engineer. Steady flow or a close low-pressure label alone does not establish unused recoverable steam or justify hardware/operating changes. Suitable existing recovery or nonapplicability may be acknowledged; unknown route, units, source or timing remains a qualified records question.
